content: {"praised": ["Unique horror‑comedy with subtle, serious tone.", "Strong acting by Guy Pearce and Robert Carlyle.", "Effective horror concepts, less slapstick, more suspense.", "Innovative, minimalistic soundtrack builds tension.", "Believable ragtag misfits, darkly comic script."], "criticized": ["Clunky directing and horrible score ruined mood.", "Goofy, anachronistic one‑liners broke immersion.", "Predictable plot, boring pacing, few twists.", "Not enough horror, felt more like drama.", "Unrealistic character, David Arquette’s role distracting."]}
